records.surface: Prepared ingress and runtime context preparation
adjudication_notes: The existing Tier A prepared-runtime family was extended before source repair to prove caller-owned nested legacy payload containers cannot mutate a prepared runtime snapshot after preparation.
The pre-repair targeted test failed because prepare_runtime_snapshot used a shallow dict copy of caller payload input.
The bounded repair deep-copies the payload mapping before alignment, derivation, and PreparedRuntimeSnapshot construction.
